/* selectOrgDept - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT C.DEPT_CD, C.INST_NO, C.UP_DEPT_CD, (SELECT D.INST_NM FROM SAA000 D /* 통합기관 */ WHERE D.INST_NO = C.INST_NO) AS INST_NM, C.DEPT_NM, C.MAIN_TASKWK_CN, C.DEPT_TELNO, C.DEPT_FXNO, C.DEL_YN, C.SRTNG_SQNCE FROM SAA300 C /* 기관부서 */ WHERE C.INST_NO = #{INST_NO} /* AND (C.DEL_YN IS NULL OR C.DEL_YN = 'N') */ ORDER BY C.SRTNG_SQNCE, C.DEPT_CD

/* selectMaxDeptCd - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT SAA300_SQ01.NEXTVAL AS DEPT_CD FROM DUAL
